text:
heather_cs: Heads up — account BlueLedge (BL-940) showing a ~65% drop in API usage over the last 30d, primary admin Marta left last week. Renewal coming up in ~45 days. Also seeing a competitor trial flag for EchoAI in their workspace.

sam_csm: Yikes. Did we receive any direct notice from them or procurement?

heather_cs: Not official, just support chatter. Support ticket #4529 has a couple threads about auth and integration flakiness. Quick usage pull: last90d avg ~12k tokens/day -> last30d avg ~4.2k tokens/day. Seats down by 3.

raj_sales: I pinged the account team — procurement reached out to EchoAI on Tue and asked for a trial. Sales has a check-in scheduled Fri.

leo_support: I attached the logs to #4529. Seeing a spike of 401s around the same time Marta rotated API keys. Could be auth token rollout impact.

emma_product: Any perf or runtime regressions in the last 7 days? We shipped a runtime patch 3 days ago.

sam_csm: @eng-runtime can you confirm if the 3-day patch had any anomalies? If not, we treat auth rotation as primary suspect.

ops-bot: DeployBot: runtime-patch-2024-03-12 deployed successfully. No automatic rollback triggered.

heather_cs: Proposed next steps: 1) 30min troubleshooting call with their interim PM (Carlos) tomorrow morning. 2) Offer 30-day dev credits + a free health-check from Solutions. 3) Prepare a concise EchoAI comparison one-pager (features, latency, cost, privacy). 4) Raj to do exec touch and procurement stall.

raj_sales: I can run the exec touch. @emma_product can you draft the one-pager? Focus on concrete differentiators: latency, per-token cost, enterprise controls, and privacy/KMS.

emma_product: Will draft an initial one-pager by EOD. Heather — can you share perf numbers + token-cost estimate so I can include concrete numbers?

heather_cs: Quick perf snippet: `30d_avg_latency: 220ms`, `90d_avg_latency: 200ms`, `token_cost_est: $0.012 / 1k tokens`. I'll DM the CSV export and paste the usage graph into the doc. Support thread: https://support/4529

leo_support: Also logged auth error samples in the ticket. Sample: `HTTP 401 x 142 spikes around 2024-03-10T08:00Z`. Requested eng to verify token rotation propagation.

sam_csm: Can we schedule a 30min rescue call? Raj said procurement + PM should be there. Carlos (interim PM) confirmed 10am PST tomorrow.

raj_sales: Confirmed 10am PST. I'll invite procurement, Carlos, Heather, Sam, Emma, and Solutions. I'll also pull any EchoAI trial details we can see.

heather_cs: :thumbsup: I'll prepare a short winback offer and invite Solutions to run the health-check during the call.

ops-bot: AccountWatchBot: Renewal watch flag created on BL-940 by heather_cs.

heather_cs: After the call I'll post action items and follow-up doc. Tagging this thread for the renewal-playbook. Thanks everyone — let's try to get them stabilized before procurement deepens the EchoAI trial.
